mutations.invariant: A child capability set never contains authority absent from its parent.
Only an external operator can clear the evolution freeze.
Unknown domain schema versions always fail closed.
Canonical domain identifiers are never empty or whitespace-only.
Genome lifecycle transitions not declared by the constitution are rejected.
A candidate mutation can never target a Law.
A candidate mutation can never target an evaluator.
An event identifier can appear only once in canonical history.
Required canonical event fields are never empty.
The single writer never appends onto a database tail changed outside its verified state.
Canonical event sequences are contiguous and globally monotonic.
Every canonical event links to the verified hash of its immediate predecessor.
Stored event content must reproduce its canonical BLAKE3 hash.
Artifact identifiers are canonical lowercase 64-character BLAKE3 hashes.
Different artifact bytes receive different content-derived addresses absent a BLAKE3 collision.
Artifact reads fail when bytes do not match the requested content address.
